name: subagent-pi-dev
description: Development-time type checking for extensions/codex-mcp-bridge.ts. No runtime dependencies: the bridge uses only Node built-ins plus typebox, which the Pi host provides to extensions. Run `npm ci` once, then `npm run typecheck`.

scripts.postinstall: node scripts/dev-setup.mjs || echo 'dev-setup skipped: pi distribution not found (typecheck unavailable)'
